svg.title: Recall architecture
svg.desc: A transit-line map. Apple Books highlights are emailed to an inbound email webhook, then a Go pipeline service parses and saves them (an enrich step is planned) into PostgreSQL. From PostgreSQL the line branches: a Python MCP server gives AI clients a read-only, five-column view, and a TanStack Start web app lets a client signed in with GitHub OAuth read highlights and update only favourite and archive.
